verdict.why: Class mocks now keep prototype methods on instances, which changes what instances of mocked classes do.

draft.detail: Instances of a class passed to vi.fn keep the prototype chain of the class, so prototype methods stay available and instanceof checks against the class pass.

test.error: FAIL: new (vi.fn(Dog))() lacks the prototype method speak and is not instanceof Dog

source.quote: Instances keep the prototype chain of the class you pass to `vi.fn`, so prototype methods stay available on instances, both during and after construction, and instances pass `instanceof` checks against that class:
